FACT_ID: sec14-F01 | anchor: A01
Every drive demands a valid license or permit on your person; misuse risks fines, jail, or suspension [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec14-F02 | anchor: A01
Permit driving needs a licensed, alert front-seat coach twenty-one or older, relaxed to eighteen through twenty only for guardians and full, half, or step siblings [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec14-F03 | anchor: A01
At nineteen or older, sixty permit days or a driver-education completion certificate unlocks the license application [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec14-F04 | anchor: A01
Underage drink-driving at .08 or higher earns full adult penalties [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec14-F05 | anchor: A01
Handing or selling alcohol to under-twenty-ones, drunks, or court-barred drinkers costs up to $2,500, suspension up to one year, and 12 months behind bars [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec14-F06 | anchor: A01
Under-twenty-one fake-ID drinking or buying draws at least $500, at least 50 service hours, up to 12 months jailed, and mandatory suspension from six months to one year under zero tolerance [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec14-F07 | anchor: A02
A regular license covers cars and small trucks under 26,001 pounds outside CDL reach [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F08 | anchor: A02
CDLs command tractor-trailers, passenger buses, tankers, sixteen-plus school buses, and hazmat haulers [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F09 | anchor: A02
Fifteen-rider school buses skip the CDL but demand commercial plus school-bus tests for an endorsement stamped with the fifteen-rider cap [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F10 | anchor: A02
International permits license nothing: mere translations for foreign travel, AAA-issued except to the suspended or revoked, while visiting drivers run on home licenses plus translations [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec14-F11 | anchor: A02
Store-bought international licenses hold no legal water, and peddling any would-be license document rates a Class 1 misdemeanor [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]
